values: 一名通过演唱召集亡魂观众的射手，擅长用普攻与弹道持续削弱敌人。
A marksman who captivates crowds with her singing and cripples enemies with relentless normal attacks and projectiles.
May this song... bring solace to the brokenhearted.
I'm just... taking a break before the next act...
This is art at its finest.
Come, perform a new play with me.
服装，造型，登台的准备，都已就绪。
I'm in costume, in full makeup, and ready to go on stage.
你的艺术品味果然不俗。
You really have exquisite taste in art.
或许可以在这里举办演出……
Perhaps I could hold a performance here...
塞涅从众多戏剧演员中脱颖而出的原因并非美貌，而是她宛如天籁的歌喉。
It is Senea's extraordinary voice, not her beauty, that sets her apart from other stage performers.
《消逝之声》的女主角夏绿蒂是塞涅的成名角色，曾有多位《消逝之声》的忠实观众表示：“没有任何演员扮演的夏绿蒂能够超越塞涅！”
Senea made her name playing Charlene, the heroine in Lost Voice. Many devoted fans of the play insist that no one could portray Charlene better than Senea.
塞涅去世后，无数戏迷涌入她的家乡为她送行，甚至自发在墓园中为她建造了一座雕像，以此纪念。
Following Senea's passing, fans from far and wide flocked to her hometown to pay their respects. They even erected a statue for her in the graveyard.
成名后，塞涅曾演绎过一个小丑角色。但由于扮相太过完美、演出太过出神入化，一度被戏迷误以为是剧团在虚假宣传。
After rising to fame, Senea once played a clown role. Her performance was so convincing that some fans suspected it was false advertising by the troupe.
据说，塞涅在赛凡纳演出时，曾有贵族一掷千金，请她为自己单独加演一场。塞涅没有拒绝，而那场加演的演出费则被她全部捐给了慈善诊所和孤儿院。
While Senea was performing in Savannah, a noble reportedly offered her an astronomical sum for a private encore. She accepted the fee and donated it in full to charitable clinics and orphanages.
比起终有一日会凋谢的鲜花，塞涅更喜欢干花和仿真花。
Senea prefers dried and artificial flowers to fresh ones that will eventually wither.
与舞台上情感充沛的表演不同，塞涅的真实性格非常端庄稳重，情绪稳定得“像是一尊完美的等身人偶”。
Senea is emotionally expressive on stage, but in real life, she is so poised and even-tempered that some liken her to "a flawless life-sized doll".
塞涅从不挑剔食物。对她来说，即便是再酸再苦的食物，也好过千奇百怪的养身药剂。
Senea is never picky about food. She would rather eat the most awful-tasting dish than swallow one of those bizarre health potions.
很少有人知道，塞涅生前的肤色和成为亡灵后相差无几，同样的缺乏血色。这或许是因为她的天生体弱。
Senea already had a pale complexion when she was alive, likely because she was frail from birth.
塞涅生前并不敌视亡灵，甚至有些羡慕这种永存的生命形式——存在是追求艺术的前提，而艺术早已超越生死。
As a human, Senea never harbored any resentment toward the Graveborn. She even longed for their immortality, believing it would let her pursue art without the limits of a mortal lifespan.
不知不觉，已经离开耀光帝国一年了。
Somehow, it's already been a year since I left the Lightbearer Empire.
这座城堡和庄园都设计得极为别致。若有机会，我想邀请剧团内的舞台设计师和道具师前来学习。
This castle and the manor are unlike anything I've ever seen. If I could, I'd bring our set designers and prop makers here to study them.
The flowers you're holding are beautiful.
